architectureDecisions: D1 — AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1 = { version, taskId, repositoryRoot, baseRevision, worktreeRoot, candidateSha, coreSessionId, toolId, toolVersion, toolSessionRef, attemptIndex, createdAt, digest }. digest is sha256 of the canonical JSON without the digest field. Written under recoveryDir/handle.json after each ACT that returns.

D2 — runSupervisedTask gains optional recoveryDir. When set, scratch is recoveryDir/worktree (created once), sessionId is agent-task:${task.id} (stable), handle is updated after each attempt, and the worktree is NOT disposed on success or EXHAUSTED; caller disposes via disposeRecoverableRun(handle). When recoveryDir is omitted, behavior matches BB-097 including finally dispose.

D3 — resumeSupervisedTask(handle, { tool, env, ... }) verifies digest, worktree exists, git rev-parse HEAD equals candidateSha or baseRevision as recorded, source repository HEAD equals the recorded observation or is reported as SOURCE_HEAD_DRIFT, then continues runSupervisedTask from attemptIndex+1 with resume.sessionRef.

D4 — Core session: inject a file-backed sessionStore under recoveryDir/core-session.json implementing load/save. Research gap: pin whether createResumableAgentRuntime is required; READY must name the delivered Core export actually used. In-memory sessionStore is not crash recovery.
D5 — Fail closed: resume with deleted worktree, rewritten digest, or a handle whose taskId already has a newer digest on disk returns a typed RECOVERY_REFUSED and does not mkdtemp.

D6 — Tests use fake CLI FIX_AFTER_FEEDBACK: after attempt 1, simulate crash by returning before attempt 2 and keeping recoveryDir; a new process/function call to resumeSupervisedTask must PROMOTE. Default path tests still pass with invocationObserver omitted.
D7 — Evidence basis: productization probe sessionIdUsesRandomUUID, disposesWorktreeInFinally, noResumeWorktreeOption; Core effect journal records RUN_AGENT_TOOL.
D8 — Living docs: docs/living/system/agent-tools/state.md plus new docs/living/system/agent-tools/recovery.md.
